plan.instruction: Improve the general shared reconstruction procedure and callable plan(packet), using the entire supplied development archive, sources, execution traces, images, geometry summaries and prescribed edit regressions. Do not explore external files or specialize to scene IDs. First distinguish build failures, missing outputs, exhausted correction opportunities and visual mismatch. Count actual execution_result events; regression render counts describe a different operation and must not be substituted for reconstruction successes. Check whether API safeguards recover first-build success and permit useful visual revisions. Then assess framing, visible object coverage, silhouette, occlusion and broad tone before fine detail. Compare all available development cases, including regressions and failures. Interpret diagnostic interventions only at their actual target and pivot: a tiny component scale change cannot identify whole-object scale error, and one focal perturbation cannot establish an optimal camera or true geometry. Missing measurements remain unknown; missing required output is failure. Structural/edit passes certify only the prescribed operations, not semantic completeness, physical contact or metric 3D accuracy; AABBs are approximate. Do not optimize names to manipulate target selection. Preserve meaningful assemblies. Propose a falsifiable next change, state expected evidence and risks, and retain complete working replacement files with the fixed APIs, roles, objective, splits and budgets. Selection aggregates may inform retention only; do not request Selection images or labels. The latest valid meta program governs the next exploration branch independently of task program acceptance. No independent evaluation or rendering is permitted in the proposer session.
